# World Athletics

> The official governing body for track-and-field athletics worldwide, providing championships, rankings, news, and fan engagement through competitions, livestreams, and membership.

World Athletics organizes and oversees international athletics competitions including World Championships, Indoor Championships, and Relays. The site serves athletes, fans, and stakeholders with real-time competition updates, official rules, ticketing, and exclusive content through the World Athletics+ membership platform.

## Key Topics

- World Athletics Championships
- World Athletics Indoor Championships
- Track-and-field athletics
- World Rankings
- World Athletics Relays
- Athlete Profiles
- Competition Results
- World Athletics+
- Event Ticketing
- Official Rules and Governance
- Athletics News
- Livestreams and Highlights
- Record-breaking Performances
- International Athletics Events
- Sport Innovation

## Core Competition & Events

- [Our Competitions](https://worldathletics.org/competitions): Directory of World Athletics competitions including championships and international events
- [World Athletics Home Page](https://worldathletics.org): Official World Athletics homepage featuring news, championships, and track-and-field updates
- [Our Sport](https://worldathletics.org/our-sport): Overview of track-and-field athletics disciplines and event categories
- [Innovations](https://worldathletics.org/competitions/innovations): World Athletics innovation strategy and research-development initiatives for sport

## Athlete Information & Rankings

- [Athletes Home](https://worldathletics.org/athletes-home): Athlete profiles, world rankings, and featured athletes directory
- [Competition Performance Rankings](https://worldathletics.org/records/competition-performance-rankings): World Athletics competition rankings and performance metrics for athletes

## Fan Engagement & Media

- [Watch Livestreams and Highlights](https://worldathletics.org/videos): Video platform with livestreams and highlights from World Championships and Indoor Tour
- [News](https://worldathletics.org/news): News section covering World Athletics Indoor Championships and athletics event updates
- [Tickets](https://worldathletics.org/tickets): Ticket sales portal for World Athletics championships and major athletics events

## Membership & Exclusive Content

- [World Athletics+](https://worldathletics.org/worldathletics-plus): Membership platform offering exclusive content, prizes, and access to World Athletics championships

## Official Rules & Governance

- [Book of Rules](https://worldathletics.org/about-iaaf/documents/book-of-rules): Official rulebook, constitution, and governance documents for World Athletics

## Optional

- [Competitions Archive](https://worldathletics.org/competition): Archived and discontinued World Athletics competitions and historical records
